args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of an 8×30 m precast-prestressed T-girder bridge (simply supported during erection, made continuous in service), one continuous unit on 7 intermediate support lines plus two abutments.

Modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, linear elastic (MR-01); system: continuous (no pier column data given → bearings on rigid supports, MR-05).
- Girder: precast t_girder, 5 per span, C50. Single midspan section A=0.862 m², I=0.4450 m⁴ (integrated from the given geometry); combined A=4.31 m², I=2.225 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5), γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w=112.06 kN/m, m=11.423 t/m (MR-07, self-weight only).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, 5 per line = 1 per girder end × 5 girders): PTFE sliding at abutments 0/8 and piers 1/2/3/6/7 (vertical spring, longitudinal free, Kh=0); plain fixed at piers 4/5 (vertical spring, longitudinal spring, Kh=15000 kN/m). S=10.714, Kv=7.098×10⁶ kN/m (JTG 3362-2018 8.7).
- Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per span (L0=30 m) (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1).

Results: first vertical bending frequency f1=4.52 Hz → impact factor μ=0.251 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2). Max live-load positive moment 8356 kN·m, max negative moment −6145 kN·m; total self-weight reaction ≈ 26.3 MN. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
